newsitem.title: QATAR: Qatar takes delivery of fourth Vosper vessel.
newsitem.headline: Qatar takes delivery of fourth Vosper vessel.

text.p: Qatar has taken delivery of a fourth strike vessel from Britain's Vosper Thornycroft, a government official said on Thursday.

"QENS (Qatar Emiri Naval Service) al-Deebel was accepted by Brigadier Issa al-Kuwari on behalf of the navy early this month and her crew is now undergoing a programme of sea-training in the UK," he said.
"The ship will set sail for Doha early next year," he added.
Al-Deebel is the last of four ships Qatar had asked Vosper Thornycroft to build for its naval forces five years ago.

The first three -- Barzan, Hawar and al-Adaid -- were received last year and are expected to arrive in Qatar within the next few weeks after an intensive sea trial and crew training, the official said.

He said all vessels included a 76 mm super-rapid dual purpose gun, a launcher for surface-to-air missiles, an advanced weapons system and two quadruple launchers for Exocet surface-to-surface missiles.
In addition to the strike vessels, Vosper Thornycroft is supplying Doha with an unspecified number of patrol crafts as part of a $810 million defence deal signed by Qatar and Britain last year.
France is the main supplier for the Qatari military, which also buys some equipment from Britain and Germany.
